title: How a Sink P-Trap Keeps Sewer Gas Out
description: The P-trap is a critical safety component in sink drainage systems designed to prevent hazardous sewer gases from entering living spaces. Positioned directly under the sink tailpiece, its curved shape traps a small volume of standing water after every use. This standing water forms a continuous physical seal across the pipe cross-section. When wastewater enters the drain, it pushes old water out into the branch line, automatically replenishing the seal with fresh water. If a fixture remains unused for extended periods or suffers from improper venting, this water seal can evaporate or siphon out, compromising air quality.
